_note: Strategy watchlists, mirroring the IBKR watchlists of the same names. Each one gets its own Discord channel after the US close (briefing/recap.py); 'channel' is the webhook name in DISCORD_WEBHOOKS. Change a list here and in IBKR together.

strategies.title: GOV FILINGS PIPELINE FINDINGS
strategies.about: Stocks the SEC and DoD filing pipeline found: contract awards, sale reviews, spin-offs and lock-ups, each with a verdict.

strategies.title: STRAT: OVERHANG
strategies.about: Registered share supply (resale S-1s, lock-up expiries) waiting to hit the market. The test: buy only after the supply has been absorbed.

strategies.title: STRAT: SPIN-OFF
strategies.about: Spin-offs and their parents: forced index and holder selling in the first weeks, then the re-rating test.

strategies.title: STRAT: ACTIVIST
strategies.about: A new 5%+ holder (13D) pushing for change: a sale, a strategic review, buybacks or board seats. The test: does the stock keep outperforming its peers after the filing?

strategies.title: STRAT: MERGER ARB (TRACKED)
strategies.about: Signed takeovers. The gap between the price and the offer, and what it says about the odds the deal fails. Tracked, not calls.
